answer: Price each identity's standing as a vine that fruits only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so its endorsements never span the ocean between distinct clusters and build no bridge to genuine standing — the vine stays barren. Honest agents root in many soils; a farm must buy a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, cost linear per fake while honest pays once.
